qa_pair.question: An article about getting an iOS app's cold launch under a time budget was shared in more than one channel, in at least one case through a link shortener. How many distinct channels shared that article? Answer with a number.
In spring 2023 the architecture channel ran a poll on how readers manage state in their declarative-UI apps. What was the third answer option? Give the option text exactly as written.
WWDC 2023 began on 5 June 2023. Which channel was the first to post about Swift's new compile-time code-generation feature on or after that date? Give the channel's username without the @.
The architecture channel reposted another channel's write-up about splitting an app into dozens of local Swift packages. What is the t.me link of the original post?
Which author signed the most posts in the Swift digest channel during 2022? Give the name exactly as it appears.
Of the posts published in 2022 about Apple's reactive-streams framework, which one received the most reactions? Give its t.me link.
Has any channel in the archive discussed gravitational waves? Answer Yes or No.
One post describes moving an onboarding flow's navigation into a type of its own. What is that type's name? Give the identifier exactly.
The Swift Evolution proposal that lets a function declare the exact error type it throws was shared in several channels. On what date was it first shared? Use YYYY-MM-DD, in UTC.
What is the date of the earliest post in the Swift digest channel that mentions Apple's declarative UI framework? Use YYYY-MM-DD, in UTC.
